description: We are enthusiastic student builders from India passionate about space exploration, web development, and interactive simulation design. Our team combines coding, UI/UX design, and NASA open-data research to build Project Lunar Outpost—an educational mission trainer that helps junior astronauts learn real lunar survival and resource management skills.
summary:
Project Lunar Outpost is an interactive web application and mission training simulator designed to help students understand the real-world challenges of sustaining human life on the Moon. Built for the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge, the app lets users manage critical lunar base resources—including oxygen levels, solar power generation, water recycling, and crew health—while responding to realistic lunar hazards such as extreme temperature swings, radiation spikes, and prolonged lunar nights.

By translating real NASA lunar environment parameters and Artemis exploration concepts into an engaging, hands-on simulation, our software turns complex space engineering trade-offs into accessible, interactive learning. Users must balance energy budgets and emergency protocols to keep their outpost operational.

This project is important because future deep-space exploration depends on inspiring and training the next generation of problem-solvers. Project Lunar Outpost makes space science approachable, demonstrates how NASA data informs habitat design, and empowers young learners to think like real mission planners.
details:
What It Does & How It Works:

Project Lunar Outpost is an interactive web-based mission training simulator built for the "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer" challenge. Players take command of a lunar South Pole habitat and manage critical life-support systems—oxygen generation, solar power storage, water recycling, and crew morale—across realistic lunar day-and-night cycles. Users make real-time operational decisions, allocate energy budgets, and respond to dynamic lunar emergencies such as solar radiation spikes, micrometeorite alerts, and extreme temperature drops.

Benefits & Intended Impact:

Space engineering concepts often feel abstract to school students. Project Lunar Outpost transforms real NASA Artemis mission constraints into an engaging, hands-on decision-making game. It helps young learners grasp resource conservation, closed-loop life support, and the harsh realities of living on the Moon while inspiring interest in STEM and space exploration.

Tools, Coding Languages & Software Used:

We developed this web application using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (React/Tailwind CSS), and deployed it as an accessible, browser-based interactive platform with version control on GitHub.

Creativity & Key Design Factors:

Rather than building a static quiz or textbook page, we designed an interactive mission control dashboard where every choice has immediate consequences on habitat survival. Key factors considered include lunar South Pole illumination windows, life-support power trade-offs, intuitive visual telemetry for junior learners, and clear educational feedback explaining the science behind each event.
